charts.title: TOI-1266 b: orbits around TOI-1266
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1266's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1266 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Cloutier et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.527.5464C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CLOUTIER_ET_AL__2024): P 10.894841 d

charts.title: TOI-1266 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1266 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (49, 75, 76) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 467179528, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
